values.note: $24 a site (2026-2028 rates). A one-time $11 fee per stay to enter the Eleven Mile Canyon Recreation Area (2026 annual pass $100); two vehicles or one RV included, $11 for a third vehicle. On-site payment by cash, check or money order at the fee tube.

values.note: 18 sites, 11 of them walk-in tent sites, so 7 take vehicles; FS: 'The max length for RVs/trailers is 30 feet.' recreation.gov's catalog lists the 7 vehicle sites at 30-50 ft (007 30, 012 32, 010 35 parallel, 013 40 pull-through, 009 45, 001 and 011 50). Up to 8 people, two tents and two vehicles or one RV a site.

values.note: Reservable on recreation.gov until 5 days before arrival; sites not reserved by then become first-come and must be occupied the same night. recreation.gov marks the 2-night weekend minimum soft, so it may be relaxed for a same-day booking. 14 consecutive nights at most. 2026 reservation season May 15 - Oct 11 (2027: May 14 - Oct 10). Check-in 2 p.m., check-out noon.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233720 (notice 'Reservations are available up to 5 days prior to arrival date. Sites not reserved 5 days before become available on a first come - first serve (FF) bases.'; rules reservationCutOff 5, minWeekendStay 2 'soft') + /rates (Peak Season 2026-05-15 to 2026-10-11, 2027-05-14 to 2027-10-10) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/riverside-campground ('No more than a 14-night consecutive stay'; 'First-come, first-served sites must be occupied the same night'; check-in/out), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 50% off the campsite the pass holder occupies (concessionaire-run).

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/riverside-campground ('The Interagency Senior Pass and the Interagency Access Pass qualify for a 50% discount at concessionaire-run campsites.'), read 2026-10-28

note: South Park RD (Pike-San Isabel NF), concessionaire-run: near the entrance of Eleven Mile Canyon, 2 mi southwest of Lake George on CR 96, ~8,000 ft, across the road from the South Platte River; large open sites, the walk-in tent sites in the pines. The 1-mile Hard Rock Interpretive Trail starts at the campground. Bear closure order in effect: store food hard-sided. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov + catalog: confirmed $24, no hookups, 18 sites, reservable. Changed max_rig_ft 90 -> 30 (FS figure; 90 was a placeholder) and added 7 vehicle sites/11 walk-in tent note, pull-through, vault toilets, no drinking water, season mid-May to mid-October, 5-day cutoff then first-come, soft 2-night weekend minimum, 14-night max, reservation season May 15 - Oct 11, senior-pass discount, $11 canyon entry fee in fees.note. Note rewritten: the internal 'RV Life listed (auto 6/2026)' remark and field facts dropped; it is in Eleven Mile Canyon, not Tarryall.
flags: Location correction for the record: this Riverside is the Eleven Mile Canyon campground on the South Platte River (CR 96, 2 mi SW of Lake George), not a Tarryall Creek campground; the old note's 'South Park/Tarryall (South Platte RD)' was wrong on both counts. It is in the South Park Ranger District. No CR 77/Tarryall Rd access is involved.

Phone missing: South Park Ranger District (719) 836-2031 (FS campground page contact; Fairplay). recreation.gov gives the concessionaire's line: 'For facility specific information, please call (661) 702-1420' (email @goexplorus.com).
Website: add the FS page https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/riverside-campground (only recreation.gov is stored).
Operator: concessionaire (Explorus, goexplorus.com) on Pike NF land; ownership left federal.

Length conflict: FS 'Max recreational vehicle (RV) length is 30 feet' (twice on the page); recreation.gov's catalog lists the 7 vehicle sites at 30-50 ft and recreation.gov's description says aprons 'can fit RVs up to 30 feet in length'. Recorded the FS 30. Only 7 of the 18 sites take a vehicle (11 are walk-in tent sites); 010 and 012 permit trailers but not RVs in the catalog.

Waterfront (stored riverview) kept: the South Platte here is ~20-30 m wide on Esri imagery and lies across CR 96 from the campground ('lies across the road from South Platte River', recreation.gov); the nearest vehicle sites (007, 013) are ~30-40 m from the water with the county road and an open bank between. The road is a developed strip, so the view call stands.

Pin 38.9577,-105.3888 is ~2 m from the catalog site centroid. Note the FS page's coordinates (38.9606,-105.3750) are ~1.3 km ENE and recreation.gov's facility point (38.9439,-105.4411) ~4.8 km WSW, both off the campground.

Status: no closure; past its mid-May to mid-October season. PSICC alert 'LaSalle Pass West and Elevenmile Canyon Entrance Occupancy and Use Restrictions' (Forest Order 2-12-10-26-03, April 13, 2026) protects raptor nests near the canyon entrance; it does not name the campground.
